description: This file contains setup and configuration logic for WhatsApp integration within the openclaw project, including functions for merging configs, detecting linked accounts, prompting user input for permissions, and finalizing setup including QR code linking.

methods.name: mergeWhatsAppConfig
methods.description: Merges partial WhatsApp account configuration into the main configuration, handling account-specific and default settings.

methods.name: setWhatsAppDmPolicy
methods.description: Sets the direct message policy for a specific WhatsApp account in the configuration.

methods.name: setWhatsAppAllowFrom
methods.description: Sets the allowFrom list for a WhatsApp account in the configuration.

methods.name: setWhatsAppSelfChatMode
methods.description: Enables or disables self chat mode for a WhatsApp account.

methods.name: detectWhatsAppLinked
methods.description: Checks if WhatsApp is linked by verifying the existence of credentials file.

methods.name: promptWhatsAppOwnerAllowFrom
methods.description: Prompts the user to input their WhatsApp number for allowlist configuration.

methods.name: applyWhatsAppOwnerAllowlist
methods.description: Applies the owner allowlist configuration after user input.

methods.name: parseWhatsAppAllowFromEntries
methods.description: Parses raw input string into a list of normalized WhatsApp numbers, validating entries.

methods.name: promptWhatsAppDmAccess
methods.description: Prompts the user to configure WhatsApp direct message access policies and allowFrom list.

methods.name: finalizeWhatsAppSetup
methods.description: Finalizes the WhatsApp setup process, including linking via QR code and configuring permissions.
